chunks.text:
## Features

- Real-time collaboration
- Diagrams (Draw.io, Excalidraw and Mermaid)
- Spaces
- Permissions management
- Groups
- Comments
- Page history
- Search
- File attachments
- Embeds (Airtable, Loom, Miro and more)
- Translations (10+ languages)

chunks.heading: React + TypeScript + Vite
chunks.text:
# React + TypeScript + Vite

This template provides a minimal setup to get React working in Vite with HMR and some ESLint rules.

Currently, two official plugins are available:

- [@vitejs/plugin-react](https://github.com/vitejs/vite-plugin-react/blob/main/packages/plugin-react/README.md) uses [Babel](https://babeljs.io/) for Fast Refresh
- [@vitejs/plugin-react-swc](https://github.com/vitejs/vite-plugin-react-swc) uses [SWC](https://swc.rs/) for Fast Refresh

chunks.heading: Expanding the ESLint configuration
chunks.text:
## Expanding the ESLint configuration

If you are developing a production application, we recommend updating the configuration to enable type aware lint rules:

- Configure the top-level `parserOptions` property like this:

```js
   parserOptions: {
    ecmaVersion: 'latest',
    sourceType: 'module',
    project: ['./tsconfig.json', './tsconfig.node.json'],
    tsconfigRootDir: __dirname,
   },
```

- Replace `plugin:@typescript-eslint/recommended` to `plugin:@typescript-eslint/recommended-type-checked` or `plugin:@typescript-eslint/strict-type-checked`
- Optionally add `plugin:@typescript-eslint/stylistic-type-checked`
- Install [eslint-plugin-react](https://github.com/jsx-eslint/eslint-plugin-react) and add `plugin:react/recommended` & `plugin:react/jsx-runtime` to the `extends` list

chunks.heading: Migrations
chunks.text:
## Migrations

```bash

chunks.heading: This creates a new empty migration file named 'init'
heading_path: This creates a new empty migration file named 'init'
chunks.text:
# This creates a new empty migration file named 'init'
$ npm run migration:create --name=init

chunks.heading: Generates 'init' migration file from existing entities to update the database schema
heading_path: Generates 'init' migration file from existing entities to update the database schema
chunks.text:
# Generates 'init' migration file from existing entities to update the database schema
$ npm run migration:generate --name=init

chunks.heading: Runs all pending migrations to update the database schema
heading_path: Runs all pending migrations to update the database schema
chunks.text:
# Runs all pending migrations to update the database schema
$ npm run migration:run

chunks.heading: Reverts the last executed migration
chunks.text:
# Reverts the last executed migration
$ npm run migration:revert

chunks.heading: Reverts all migrations
chunks.text:
# Reverts all migrations
$ npm run migration:revert

chunks.heading: Shows the list of executed and pending migrations
heading_path: Shows the list of executed and pending migrations
chunks.text:
# Shows the list of executed and pending migrations
$ npm run migration:show
